bugLogs.title: Insufficient Color Contrast
affected_users: older users with declining contrast sensitivity
steps_to_reproduce: Open the webpage in a browser
Navigate to the elements with the class 'discount' and the class 'checkout-btn'
Observe the color contrast between the text and the background
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The elements have insufficient color contrast, with a ratio of 2.16 for the 'discount' class and 3.13 for the 'checkout-btn' class
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Increase the darkness of the text color or lighten the background color to achieve a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
bugLogs.element_selector: tr:nth-child(2) > td:nth-child(3) > span, tr:nth-child(3) > td:nth-child(3) > span, .checkout-btn

bugLogs.title: Missing lang attribute
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The HTML document should have a lang attribute to specify the language of the content.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The HTML document does not have a lang attribute.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute to the html element, e.g., <html lang="en">

bugLogs.title: Missing Image Alt Text
bugLogs.expected_behavior: All non-text content has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Images are missing alt text, making them inaccessible to screen readers and other assistive technologies.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to all informative images, and use alt="" (empty) only for truly decorative images.

bugLogs.title: Missing form labels
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Form elements should have labels to provide clear instructions for users
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Form elements are missing labels, making it difficult for users to understand the purpose of the fields
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add visible, persistent labels above or beside every form input using the 'label' element and 'for' attribute
